FN-ARY2BQS-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 278
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Shay Shelnutt
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/08/2025
Senate Bill 278 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of certain local
boards of education by requiring the implementation of released time policy adopted by the
State Board of Education, which are permissive under current law.
